metadata.description: Curated Claude Code skills + the skill-detectors framework. Plugins use commit-SHA versioning, so every push refreshes consumers on next session start.

plugins.name: catalog
plugins.description: A generated index of every skill in the unatt marketplace, including plugins not installed on this machine. Regenerated on every release, so it is never out of date with the repo.

plugins.name: claude-stack
plugins.description: Anthropic ecosystem + cross-model tools: Claude API / Agent SDK app development (with prompt caching), MCP server building, Gemini CLI for large-context review, parallel Gemini + Codex cross-validation (multi-ai-review), and a bundled monthly-refreshed LLM API pricing reference (llm-api-pricing).

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Content + document tools: Office documents (docx/pptx/xlsx create+edit), PDF manipulation (extract, create, merge, forms) and structural page-ops (pdf-ops: merge/split/rotate/stamp), document-grounded analysis on local files (notebook, NotebookLM-style FTS5+MCP) or Google NotebookLM (browser-driven), ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English (ste, with a paired Claude Code output style), and meme generation via memegen.link.

plugins.name: design-taste
plugins.description: Design taste for any visual surface: surface modes, anti-slop rules, task references adapted from Impeccable, a local catalog of directions with dealing, and offline source and render checkers.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Browser and machine operations: authenticated Firefox control, the serious-research procedure with Reddit, Facebook comment exports, LAN access, privileged commands, setup wizards, deployment tooling, Bottles installs, and native game trainers.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Code review and security audit procedures — for CLIs without built-in review commands

plugins.name: skill-detectors
plugins.description: Two-leg framework that surfaces context-conditional skills automatically. SessionStart hook watches disk state and emits SKILL_SIGNAL markers (offer/route/constrain). UserPromptSubmit hook watches chat content and emits SKILL_SIGNAL_CANDIDATE markers when the user mentions something that may warrant a new detector. Solves the 'I installed it but always forget to invoke it' problem for context-conditional tools.

plugins.name: skill-management
plugins.description: Discover, create, and propagate Claude Code skills: find-skills (search/install from ecosystem), skill-development (full TDD lifecycle), skill-enhance (propagate a tech across your library).

plugins.name: universal-modder
plugins.description: Game modding and repair workflows, engine recon, asset pipelines and field notes. Vendored from rehan-remade/universal-modder (MIT).

plugins.name: reverse-tooling
plugins.description: Complementary artifact inspection with REA and persistent, evidence-driven Ghidra analysis.
